### Stochastic Integral

The foundation of stochastic calculus are integrals with respect to
**diffusions** which are a class of continuous-time
[[markov-process|Markov processes]] with almost surely continuous sample paths.
There are several potential integral constructions, for example by **Itô** and
by **Stratonovich**.
